info.name: Macrometa API Reference Activity Metrics Change History API

params.name: from
params.description: Optional. Filter results from a specified date and time in UTC (e.g. 2022-01-01T00:00:00Z).

params.name: to
params.description: Optional. Filter results up to a specified date and time in UTC (e.g. 2022-01-01T00:00:00Z).

params.name: limit
params.description: Optional. Limit the number of results (positive integer, default is 20).

params.name: offset
params.description: Optional. Offset the results by a non-negative integer (default is 0).

items.docs: Get the change history of PhotonIQ EST service.
